parameters.content:
## PF Session Follow-up
Input: `{ invitee_uri, mode }`. One run per session.

The question is a Slack DM with two **links** (not buttons), so clicks never reach the recruiting interactivity handler. Each link resumes this run with `answer=yes` or `answer=no`. After the answer or the timeout, the message is edited: links removed, answer shown.

No answer: one reminder (mock 3 min, real 24 h), then `unanswered`. Only an explicit `yes` / `no` counts as an answer.

smtp.name: SMTP Mailgun n8n official (use it with "info.n8n.io")

nodeGroups.name: Check session
nodeGroups.description: Loads config and the session row, checks it is active and the host passes the mock guard, builds texts.

nodeGroups.name: Ask host
nodeGroups.description: DMs the host a yes/no question with links, waits until the session end, then edits the message to show the answer.

nodeGroups.name: Reminder
nodeGroups.description: No first answer: asks once more (mock 3 min, real 24 h), then edits the message.

nodeGroups.name: Joined
nodeGroups.description: Marks showed_up, waits until the session end, then starts PF Reward.

nodeGroups.name: Ask before rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Marks no_show, asks the host if the participant should get a rebook email, edits the message with the decision.

nodeGroups.name: Prepare rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Host said yes: marks approved, builds the email, applies the mock guard.

nodeGroups.name: Send rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Sends from noreply@info.n8n.io through Mailgun, stamps the row, edits the DM with the send time.

nodeGroups.name: Email blocked
nodeGroups.description: Guard or missing data: nothing sent, row marked guard_blocked, DM says why.
